Class GLImageDesc

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.engine.ImageDesc
icyllis.arc3d.opengl.GLImageDesc
@Immutable public final class GLImageDesc extends ImageDesc
Descriptor to create OpenGL images (textures and renderbuffers). The mGLFormat here should be a sized, internal format for the texture. We use the sized format since the base internal formats are deprecated.

Note the target can be GL30C.GL_RENDERBUFFER.
